sourceAnswer: CN514 print499 and officialall4a-prephysical27/printed27 dated2016-06-30 both explicitly print second t expansion (t-(t>>1))+t. The first shift is also1 and is unchanged by the candidate.
officialQualification: The historical official page itself prints1, not7; its adjacent explanatory y_y is also literal original typography. This receipt does not call7 an official erratum.
